Low-level ZwiftRacing.app GET

zr_get.Rd

Low-level ZwiftRacing.app GET

Usage

zr_get(client, path, query = list(), parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zr"))

zr_rider(client, zwift_id, ...)

zr_rider_overview(client, zwift_id, ...)

zr_rider_results(
  client,
  zwift_id,
  days = 365,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zr")
)

zr_rider_ranking(client, zwift_id, days = 90, ...)

zr_rider_velo(client, zwift_id, days = 365, ...)

zr_rider_power(client, zwift_id, ...)

zr_riders(client, ids, ...)

zr_event(client, event_id, ...)

zr_result(client, event_id, parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zr"))

zr_club(client, club_id, ...)

zr_club_riders(client, club_id, page = NULL, ...)

zr_routes(client, ...)

Arguments

client

A zr_client().

path

Endpoint path under /api/v2, e.g. "/riders/123".

query

Named list of query parameters.

parse

One of "tbl", "json", "resp".

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds (0 = off, Inf = permanent).

zwift_id

Zwift rider id.

...

For the typed wrappers, further arguments forwarded to zr_get().

days

Look-back window in days.

ids

Vector of Zwift rider ids.

event_id

Zwift event id.

club_id

Club id.

page

Page number (0-based), or NULL for all pages.

Value

A tibble, parsed list, or httr2 response.

Functions

  • zr_rider(): A rider's current profile: vELO rating (velo$race, with velo$factors), race counts (race$finishes/wins/podiums/dnfs), power, points, phenotype and club.

  • zr_rider_overview(): Rider overview, including the legacy ZwiftRacing ratings (legacyRatings$live/max30/max90) and rating history.

  • zr_rider_results(): A rider's race results over the last days days. One row per race (nested event, place, race, velo, legacy objects, flattened to dotted column names).

  • zr_rider_ranking(): A rider's ranking / points over the last days days.

  • zr_rider_velo(): A rider's vELO rating history over the last days days.

  • zr_rider_power(): A rider's power curve, efforts and FTP estimate.

  • zr_riders(): Several riders' profiles, one row each. API v2 has no batch endpoint, so this makes one (throttled, cached) request per rider; riders that error (e.g. not found / opted out) are dropped with a warning.

  • zr_event(): Event metadata (route, distance, pens with summary stats).

  • zr_result(): Race results for an event: one row per rider across all pens, with a pen column. Includes position, category, time, power (wkg*), and ratings (ratingBefore, rating, ratingDelta, riderVelo.race).

  • zr_club(): Club summary (name, colours, rider counts).

  • zr_club_riders(): Club members with ratings. Pages hold 50 riders and are 0-indexed; page = NULL (default) fetches every page and binds them.

  • zr_routes(): Route catalogue.
